title: Worksheet: Monthly Subscription Charge on the Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
The monthly subscription charge of a Pocketwire Business Profile is computed from the list fee.

**List fee.** The list fee is the monthly subscription fee of the tier the profile holds after the month's review, as the subscription price list states it for that tier.

**The charge.** The plan bundle percentage and the volume relief percentage are first added into one combined percentage; the list fee is then reduced once by that combined percentage; the subscription tenure credit, in dollars, is subtracted from that reduced fee; the result is never below zero; and it is rounded to the nearest cent only at that last step. Charged with no percentage off and no credit, the charge is the list fee itself, kept to the cent.

Put as a sequence of quantities within the one calculation:

1. combined percentage: the plan bundle percentage plus the volume relief percentage;
2. reduced fee: the list fee less the combined percentage of the list fee, taken once on the list fee;
3. charge before rounding: the reduced fee less the subscription tenure credit, and zero if that is below zero;
4. charge: that amount rounded to the nearest cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, not company figures)

| List fee | Combined percentage | Tenure credit | Reduced fee | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| USD 40.00 | none | none | USD 40.00 | USD 40.00 |
| USD 40.00 | 10% plus 25%, i.e. 35% | none | USD 26.00 | USD 26.00 |
| USD 33.33 | 15% | USD 1.00 | USD 28.3305 | USD 27.33 |
| USD 4.00 | 60% | USD 3.00 | USD 1.60 | USD 0.00 (never below zero) |

In the third row the reduced fee keeps its fractional cents until the credit has been subtracted; the rounding to USD 27.33 is the last step.
